text:
incident-bot: ALERT: multi-region failover monitor firing (eu-west primary) — increased 5xx ratio + inter-region latency spike. Pager: alex (oncall). auto-page: yes.
Alex (oncall): acked. jumping in. can someone paste the fastcheck results?
Maria R: looks like traffic shifted from eu-west to eu-central unexpectedly ~10:12 UTC, some requests routing looped. customer impact: small subset of EU customers seeing 500s intermittently. classifying P2 for now.
Jamal S: adding context — autoscaling hit soft limit in eu-west and we saw reconnect storms to the LB. logs: ```ERROR connection reset by peer at proxy/conn.go:214
[kv] kvcache miss rate spiked 3x```
Evan C: oncall notes: i bumped the pool in eu-west and triggered canary routing back to primary; still seeing failover-alert spam. proposed mitigation: suppress repeat alert noise, tune threshold to 3% 5xx over 2m instead of 1% over 1m.
Alex (oncall): doing the suppression now. OpsBot: `!snooze alert failover-monitor eu-west 30m` -> confirmed.
Li W: we should add a new dashboard panel for cross-region request ratio and kvcache miss rate. I'll draft queries. Grafana query for cross-region ratio: ```sum(rate(requests_total{region=~"eu-.*",route!~"internal"}[1m])) by (region) / sum(rate(requests_total[1m]))``` failover alert proposal: trigger when region_ratio drops >20% vs 5m baseline AND 5xx_rate > 0.03 over 2m.
Maria R: +1. also noisy symptom: multiple alerts firing for the same root cause. propose a composite alert that groups by incident_id tag.
Jamal S: created ticket INF-823 to track alert tuning + dashboard. linking runbook changes: https://confluence.internal/r/runbooks/failover-monitoring (will add examples).
Alex (oncall): customer comms? CS flagged 2 top-tier customers complaining latency. Maria, can you craft an interim note?
Maria R: draft: "We're investigating intermittent 500s affecting EU region customers. We have rolled additional capacity and tuned monitoring to reduce false positives. We'll post updates every 30m." posting to #customer-notify in 5.
Evan C: post-incident actions: 1) increase autoscaler headroom in eu-west; 2) add prefix/KV cache warming after redeploys; 3) implement composite alert and new dashboards; 4) review routing weights to prevent oscillation.
Alex (oncall): handing to weekend oncall Jamal in 30m for follow through. Jamal, please pick up next steps and own the postmortem.
Jamal S: ack. i'll collect timeline and blotter, and schedule postmortem meeting. Actions assigned in INF-823.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: last seen 1789509123 — failover traffic normalizing, alert rate reduced after suppression and scale up. closing page if no regressions in 1h.
Li W: will open PR for grafana panels and alert rules. tag me for review, i want to include a synthetic check that verifies cookie-sticky routing.
Alex (oncall): thanks team. small follow-up: please avoid lowering threshold below 2m window without SRE approval — we almost missed the autoscaler signal earlier.
Maria R: noted. i'll post a summary + timeline to the incident channel and attach the customer note after the next update. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: runbook snapshot attached: runbook:v2.1 — metrics to check: region_ratio, 5xx_rate, kvcache_miss, lb_conn_errors.
Jamal S: closing handoff, i'll file the postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow.
Alex (oncall): resolved for now. thanks everyone.
